details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, and K6 are all PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K7 and K8 are MISSING entirely – no mention of Botnica icebreaker utilization/rescue operations or environmental sustainability metrics (renewable energy, GHG emissions, circularity initiatives). The summary captures most HIGH-priority financial, operational, strategic, and geopolitical points, but omits two MEDIUM-priority items, resulting in a 'Generally yes' assessment.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: the summary acknowledges a slight revenue decline (S2) but explains how this was offset by other segments (S3), leading to improved profitability metrics (S4-S6). Operational details (S7-S11) align with the stated drivers of performance. Cost reductions (S15) logically support the improved margins. Strategic investments (S16) and balance sheet items (S17) are presented as complementary elements of the overall performance narrative. The summary flows logically from performance overview to operational details to financial metrics and strategic context, with no internal contradictions, gaps, or confusing repetitions. Market challenges (S13-S14) are presented as context for the recovery rather than contradictions to the positive results.
